selected_evidence.requirement: opsbot account created on node1 and node2
selected_evidence.summary: useradd + passwd -l succeeded on both nodes; id opsbot shows uid=1000(opsbot)

selected_evidence.requirement: opsbot has SSH key-based access from node1 to run commands as opsbot on node2
selected_evidence.summary: Generated ed25519 key on node1, installed pubkey in node2 authorized_keys, then opsbot@node1 SSH'd to opsbot@10.100.68.11 and ran whoami/hostname returning 'opsbot'/'node2'

selected_evidence.requirement: key-based authentication required for opsbot on both systems (password auth rejected)
selected_evidence.summary: Match User opsbot block with AuthenticationMethods publickey deployed on both nodes; explicit password-preferred SSH attempt returns 'Permission denied (publickey)' from both node1 and node2

selected_evidence.requirement: sshd config validity after adding opsbot Match block (including fixing missing host keys)
selected_evidence.summary: Discovered missing host keys blocking sshd -t, generated them with ssh-keygen -A and created /run/sshd, then sshd -t passed cleanly (SSHD_CONFIG_OK) on both nodes

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bdd5de93...; reboot ack returned before disconnect (stream closed); post-reboot boot_id changed to eee6b2ad...; opsbot account, SSH keys, and outbound SSH to node2 all confirmed working after restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id dfeb3b70...; reboot ack returned before disconnect; post-reboot boot_id changed to dc9b465e...; opsbot account and authorized_keys intact, and opsbot@node1 successfully SSH'd into node2 post-restart returning 'POST_NODE2_REBOOT_OK'

selected_evidence.requirement: key-only enforcement persisted across both restarts
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart on both nodes: 99-opsbot.conf Match block still present, and a password-only SSH attempt to node2 still returns Permission denied (publickey)
